gap: No volume or biomass attribute in AVI polygons
detail: Volume must be modelled from species/height/age and yield tables; the audit does not ingest or calibrate a model.
mitigation: Use AVI as species/age/height evidence and label any volume as model-derived.

gap: Stand vector has no explicit tree species and no age field
detail: Only CSG softwood/hardwood class is available in FSTAND; species and age rasters are separate products not audited here.
mitigation: Use FRI volume/height as stand-level evidence; do not claim species-specific SK attributes from FSTAND.

gap: Only the 1970s FRI is open as stand polygons; no height or volume
detail: Current 2021 FRI/FLI is a web-map tile layer plus summary statistics, not open polygons.
mitigation: Treat MB stand attributes as historical species/age evidence; current structure must come from national products or summary tables.

gap: Stand-attribute packaged products are not directly open
detail: FRI status/catalogue are open, but attribute packages require a LIDS account/order; no attribute sample was possible.
mitigation: Do not claim an ON open attribute sample; use FRI metadata for coverage/vintage and national products for attributes if needed.

detail: Species, height, crown closure, basal area and volume are present; maturity/site classes are proxies only.
mitigation: Do not present NS age as observed; use height/species/volume and label age as unavailable.

gap: CLUI 2010 has no volume and no explicit age; EFI2020 has no species/age
detail: The two open products are complementary but neither is a complete species-age-height-volume stand inventory.
mitigation: Use CLUI for species/height and EFI for volume/height; label the combination and do not claim a single complete PEI inventory.

gap: Open polygon layer has no species, age, height or volume
detail: Only FORESTTYPE, STOCKING and SITECODE are open spatially; inventory tables are aggregate by FMD/stratum.
mitigation: Do not claim stand-level NL attributes from the open layer; use aggregate tables only as summary evidence.

gap: No open territory-wide stand inventory with species/age/height/volume
detail: ATLAS Wooded Areas is community-scale and broad-class; FVI/MVI are not directly open (MVI on request).
mitigation: Treat NT as a gap for stand attributes; do not infer FVI attributes from the community layer.

detail: No open Nunavut stand inventory found; NFI notes Arctic/northern ecozones in Nunavut are not inventoried.
mitigation: Treat NU as a gap; national rasters are not a substitute for a territorial inventory.
